title: Figure 10: HEL weapon basic tracking and pointing controls; Fig. 11 SeaLite Beam Director
description: Schematic of a gimbal-mounted HEL telescope with a sensor and gyro, linked in a control loop through Tracker, Stabilization Electronics and Mount drive blocks, with azimuth and elevation rotations and angle labels θ error, θ sensor, θ target and θ HEL aimed at a rocket. Captioned "Figure 10. HEL Weapon Basic Tracking and Pointing Controls." Lower right is Figure 11, a color cutaway illustration of the "SeaLite Beam Director" showing internal optics and a beam path.
